info.title: DataCentral Pulse API
info.description: Generated route inventory and shared Zod input schemas. Application sessions, current accounts and scoped membership govern access. If-Match protects edits/publication; idempotent writes bind caller, body and target. JSON limit: 64 KiB. See docs/production-hardening.md.

get.description: System admin only. Returns the saved settings (sender, safe mode, tracking, caps, boilerplate) and, beside them, what the environment says: whether SENDGRID_API_KEY and SENDGRID_EVENT_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY are set (never their values), the URL to enter in SendGrid's Event Webhook settings, and the effective sending state. Until a System admin has saved settings, the defaults are returned: sending off, safe mode on for datacentral.ai.

patch.description: System admin only. Replaces the settings with the whole object in the body, validated and normalised (addresses and domains in lower case, repeated domains dropped). fromEmail is required while sending is enabled, and so is unsubscribeGroupId unless safe mode is on (400 INVALID_UNSUBSCRIBE_GROUP_REQUIRED). Writes the audit event communication.settings.updated with the settings before and after. Answers like the GET.

200.description: The settings as saved, and their status.

post.description: System admin only; the request has no body. Sends one test mail to the signed-in admin with the saved settings, straight to the provider and not through the delivery queue, whether or not sending is enabled. The mail says Sending state: followed by the effective sending state the Settings card shows. Safe mode still applies: the admin's own domain must be on its list, or safe mode off (400 INVALID_SAFE_MODE_BLOCKS_RECIPIENT). 400 INVALID_EMAIL_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION means no from address is saved or, in production, that SENDGRID_API_KEY is not set (as for the worker, production does not take the console transport). 400 INVALID_EMAIL_PROVIDER_<code> is a refusal from SendGrid, named by its HTTP status or network code alone, never by its message (HTTP_401 and HTTP_403 mean a rotated key, an unverified sender or the wrong region). Outside production, without SENDGRID_API_KEY the console transport takes the mail, logs a count and answers transport console.

200.description: The provider accepted the mail (or, with transport console, the server log did).

providerMessageId.description: SendGrid's x-message-id; null in sandbox mode, which answers without one.

get.summary: Estimate who a send would reach
get.description: Any internal role. Resolves the audience the campaign would be frozen with now and answers with its counts, never an address; nothing is written. Beside the counts it carries effectiveSendingState, what the worker would do with the send now (the state the Settings card shows, which only a System admin can read there), so the person who sends sees that sending is off, in sandbox or held to safe mode before pressing Send. 400 INVALID_AUDIENCE_TOO_LARGE when the audience is over the recipient limit; an audience nobody belongs to is reported with a total of 0.

200.description: The counts of the audience and the effective sending state.

post.description: Receives SendGrid's signed event batches (delivered, bounce, open, click, unsubscribe and so on). Anonymous: it is authenticated by the ECDSA signature in X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature, made over the value of the timestamp header followed by the raw body, and checked against SENDGRID_EVENT_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY; a timestamp more than ten minutes from now is refused. The body is at most 1 MiB, and this route is exempt from the 64 KiB / 250-item JSON limit of the other routes. Each event is applied once (idempotent on sg_event_id). It answers 503 until the key is configured, so that SendGrid keeps retrying.

200.description: The batch was read. applied counts the events that changed a delivery or the suppression list; ignored counts repeated events and events that match nothing.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Opaque version from the latest entity read. Reread on 412; missing precondition returns 428.

webhookUrl.description: The URL to enter in SendGrid's Event Webhook settings.

effectiveSendingState.description: What the worker would do now: disabled (the switch is off), provider-missing (on, but no API key), sandbox (SendGrid validates and delivers nothing), safe-mode (only allow-listed domains), live.

members.description: Rows that come from Pulse users.

contacts.description: Rows that come from a company's contact list.

internal.description: Rows that come from the internal staff copy.

suppressed.description: Rows that will not be mailed, counted by reason (PreferenceOff, SafeMode, Unsubscribed, Bounced, SpamReport, Manual).

total.description: Every row, the suppressed ones included.

effectiveSendingState.description: What the worker would do now: disabled (the switch is off), provider-missing (on, but no API key), sandbox (SendGrid validates and delivers nothing), safe-mode (only allow-listed domains), live.
